mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dpm_requirement (version_id, requirement_no, title, requirement_type, content_markdown, status, priority, owner_name, sort_order) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{requirementNo}, #{title}, #{requirementType}, #{contentMarkdown}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{ownerName}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_requirement SET requirement_no = #{request.requirementNo}, title = #{request.title}, requirement_type = #{request.requirementType}, content_markdown = #{request.contentMarkdown}, status = #{request.status}, priority = #{request.priority}, owner_name = #{request.ownerName}, sort_order = #{request.sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
